parameters.query: WITH d AS (INSERT INTO soins.sgb6_dossiers (id, questionnaire, aidant, personne, recu_le) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::date) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO soins.sgb6_journal (dossier_id, etape, outil, resultat, choisi_par, soignant) SELECT id, 'depot', 'deposer', 'questionnaire déposé', 'humain', $6 FROM d RETURNING dossier_id AS id
SELECT s.identifiant, g.nom, s.jeton_hash FROM soins.sessions s JOIN soins.soignants g ON g.identifiant = s.identifiant WHERE s.jeton_hash = $1 AND s.expire_le > now() AND g.actif
